 CORAM : MANGESH S. PATIL, J.
 DATE : 26.02.2020 P.C. :-

The applicant is seeking bail in the event of his arrest in connection with Crime No.605/2019 registered with Hingoli City Police Station, Dist.Hingoli for the offences punishable under Section 328, 188, 272, 273 of I.P.C. and under Section 59 of Food, Safety and Standards Act.
2] The allegations are to the effect that on 23/10/2019 a car in which the accused nos. 1 and 2 were travelling was intercepted.
On search, it was found that a stock of Gutkha was being transported worth Rs.61,800/-.
On an inquiry with the accused nos.1 and 2, they disclosed that they had obtained the stock from the present applicant.
3] The learned advocate for the applicant submits that except Section 328 of the I.P.C. the other offences are bailable.
Section 328 of the I.P.C. is not applicable as there are no allegations about the Gutkha having been administered to anybody.
The other two accused have been granted bail.
It is (2) 11-aba57 only on the basis of statement of the co-accused that the applicant is being implicated which is a very weak piece of material.
Applicant is ready to cooperate the Investigating Officer.
There are no criminal antecedents and he may be granted bail subject to suitable conditions.
4] The learned A.P.P. opposes the application.
He submits that the offence is serious.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accused nos. 1 and 2 have been caught red handed.
Applicant is the prime accused who had supplied the stock to the co-accused.
The investigation is in progress.
Interrogation of the applicant is imperative to complete it.
Application may be rejected.
5] I have carefully gone through the papers.
There cannot be any dispute as to the fact that except Section 328 of the I.P.C. the other offences being charged are all bailable.
6] So far as Section 328 of the I.P.C. is concerned, the very use of the word "administered" contained in the provision suggests that there has to be administration of the intoxicant to somebody.
Mere finding some person in possession of an intoxicant per se would fall short of necessary ingredients for constituting the offence.
7] Besides, except statement of the co-accused which is rather inadmissible in evidence that the applicant is being sought to be implicated.
There are no criminal antecedents.
The entire stock has already been seized.
In these circumstances, applicant deserves to be granted anticipatory bail.
(3) 11-aba57 8] The application is allowed.

9] In the event of arrest of the applicant in connection with Crime No.605/2019 registered with Hingoli City Police Station, Dist.Hingoli for the offences punishable under Section 328, 188, 272, 273 of I.P.C. and under Section 59 of Food, Safety and Standards Act,
he shall be released on bail on his executing personal recognizance for an amount of Rs.15,000/-
(Rs.Fifteen thousand only) and furnishing a solvent surety in the like amount subject to following conditions :
a] He shall attend the concerned Police Station as and when called by the Investigating Officer and shall cooperate him.
b] He shall not tamper the evidence or influence the witnesses.
[MANGESH S. PATIL, J.]
